newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GOLF-GAUTENG NORTH WIN INTER-PROVINCIAL PROMOTION.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-GAUTENG NORTH WIN INTER-PROVINCIAL PROMOTION.

text.p: Gauteng North won promotion to section 'A' of the inter-provincial golf championships despite losing their final match to Western Transvaal at Clovelly Country Club on Friday.
The six points Gauteng North had already accumulated for three wins earlier in the week was enough to see them go up despite an 8-4 defeat by Western Transvaal.

They replace Border who were relegated from section 'A' after losing their fourth match of the week to Natal who finished runners-up to Western Province. Western Province had clinched the title on Thursday.

After the conclusion of the tournament Western Province captain Hennie Walters was named with Hennie Otto (Western Transvaal), Andrew McLardy (Southern Transvaal) and Warren Abery (Natal) in South Africa's team for the Eisenhower Trophy tournament forinternational amateur teams which takes place in the Philippines between November 14 and 17.

Eastern Province (1 pt) halved with Southern Transvaal (1pt), 6-6. Foursomes: Eastern Province 1 and a half, Southern Transvaal 2 and a half. Singles: Eastern Province 4 and a half, Southern Transvaal 3 and a half.
Natal (2 pts) beat Border (0pts), 9-3. Foursomes: Natal 4, Border 0. Singles: Natal 5, Border 3.
